observations: Metallic gearbox casing with visible wear and surface rust.
Two electrical motors (starter motors) mounted on the casing.
A blue painted area on the side of the casing.
A star-shaped pattern on the front cover.
The unit appears to be a used or scrap part.
Watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: The seller's business description cannot be verified from the photos of a single part.
The photos do not show any Japanese text, logos, or part numbers to confirm the origin.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or seized gears
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being operated through its input and output shafts.
A photo of the shafts being removed from the casing.
A photo of the gearbox identification plate showing the part number and specifications.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the gearbox identification plate (usually on the side or back).
Video of the gearbox being operated to confirm it turns and shifts gears.
Photo of the input and output shafts to confirm they are present and intact.
response.reason: The item is a used automatic gearbox. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional scrap part until proof of mechanical condition and compatibility is provided.
